about_the_game:
Echoes of a forgotten era seep from the Fable. Its veil - once shielding reality from the monstrosities of eld - is fading away. Venture into its pages, confront the vengeful myths trapped inside, and restore control over its eternal seal.

Mythbreak is a PvP arena brawler featuring fast-paced asymmetrical gameplay. Dive into the action as one of three heroes working together to take down a fearsome boss - or unleash havoc by becoming the boss itself. Whether you are coordinating strategies as a team or dominating the battlefield with sheer force, Mythbreak offers dynamic battles packed with action.

  • ASYMMETRICAL ARENA ACTION
    Experience a new take on PvP brawling with Mythbreak’s 3v1 format. Play as part of a coordinated team of three heroes - or as a mighty boss with devastating power. Each hero and boss boasts a unique skill set and playstyle, opening up countless strategies and ways to play. Combining the thrill of raid battles with the competitive spirit of an arena brawler, Mythbreak delivers a fresh and engaging gameplay experience.

  • UNCOVER THE PAST
    Delve into the Fable, a magical relic that seals ancient myths within its pages. As you face its vengeful bosses with your friends, collect different memoria to gradually uncover their dark histories - and the secrets behind their eternal imprisonment.

  • ENJOY WITH FRIENDS
    As an online multiplayer game with a focus on teamwork, Mythbreak is designed to be a shared experience. Rally your squad, choose your roles, and discover the myths of the Fable together.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher (64 bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2070 / AMD Radeon 5700 XT
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
